summary:
Returns a mapping filtered by `ob->fun()` or function pointer `f`. Each key/value pair is passed to the filter function, followed in order by any `extra` arguments. A pair is removed when the filter returns 0 and retained otherwise. The filter arguments have the form: fun(mixed key, mixed value, mixed extra,...);

This is essentially the filter() efun overload: mapping filter(mapping, string | function, ...);
